AUDIT-7 Lane 4 suspect-closure pointer: #787 / #7734, #12926, #13267

The code remainder from #7734 is now landed: #12926 supplies Slice D (the cross-language parity oracle), and #13267 supplies Slices E/F (SSH negotiation/framing and browser opt-in). But #787's own comment #7101492168 says the final acceptance still needs one supported-terminal smoke session plus unsupported-terminal fallback evidence against a real terminal. No such evidence appears in the current issue comments.

Current API state shows #787 closed at 2026-11-23T20:52:00Z, three seconds after #13267 merged. #13267's body explicitly says it does not close #787 and repeats the outstanding real-terminal acceptance. This looks like the same negated-close accidental closure previously recorded for #7734 and #12926. Lane 4 has not reopened the issue; passing this closure correction to Lane 2 for its disposition.

Evidence: [#787 acceptance and comments](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/787), [#7734 Slice C](https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/7734), [#12926 Slice D](https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/12926), [#13267 Slices E/F](https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/13267).
